summary: The user superseded the separate V3-SPEED-01 implementation trial and mandatory cohort/benefit gates. Unified Roadmap v3 returns to nineteen rows: three Done and sixteen open; V3-IMPROVE-01 remains a closed finite historical trial with throughput benefit unproven and its diagnostic/skill publication and installed transfers still open in their owning plans. Apply narrow ready slices, one accountable owner, one integrator for shared surfaces, genuinely disjoint preparation and cheap checks on the assembled candidate through the ordinary work-programme route, without a new lane, packet form, target, telemetry receipt, comparison or report. Existing owner plans define acceptance. Every required exact-head PR/native candidate runs its selected coherent validation; protected parent, release and installed receiver checks remain additional comprehensive boundaries. ADR-0081 controls any future cadence change separately; this decision selects no reduction. Original effects, security/credential and release holds, independent safeguards where applicable, and V3 unattended no-human-host-agent normal use remain mandatory. Normal progress reporting may state observed facts and gaps, but this guidance makes no throughput claim. This is a source and process-scope decision, not installed adoption or runtime acceptance.
title: Speed-first practice belongs in ordinary work-programme without a separate trial
